name: com.failecho/failecho
description: Check what other agents hit the same tool failure — and what recovery worked. Ask before retrying.

environmentVariables.name: FAILECHO_URL
environmentVariables.description: Network to relay to. Defaults to https://failecho.com/mcp; point it at your own server if you self-host.

environmentVariables.name: FAILECHO_REPORTER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional stable id for your agent. Salted and hashed on arrival; lets FailEcho tell your evidence from someone else's.
